tasks.label: Validate Django employee project
tasks.command: python manage.py check; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { python manage.py makemigrations employees }; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { python manage.py test }

tasks.label: Create MySQL database and validate
tasks.command: python -c "from dotenv import load_dotenv; import os, pymysql; load_dotenv(); conn=pymysql.connect(host=os.getenv('DB_HOST'), port=int(os.getenv('DB_PORT')), user=os.getenv('DB_USER'), password=os.getenv('DB_PASSWORD')); cursor=conn.cursor(); cursor.execute('CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS Employee_Information CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci'); conn.close()"; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { python manage.py migrate }; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { python manage.py test }

tasks.label: Create Employee Information database
